items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gene Ammons and whoever else was in the sax section wasn’t making it obviously

ctx.x: No. The big band at Philharmonic Hall with Mulligan, Gene Ammons, and all the eight saxs.
I was just invited. Probably Sy Johnson called me. He was kind of in charge of all that. I was more than happy to try it.
